desc: Ideation: reduce "delete x" to folding gap-segment summaries (sum, pref, suff, best); plan O(n log n) segment-tree approach with O(1) end-gaps via prefix/suffix folds and O(log n) internal-gap queries (total internal gaps = n - distinct).
Implement the full solution in the starter code: iterative segment tree with combine, prefix/suffix fold arrays, per-value gap folding, global max including no-op baseline.
Verify against both provided examples (expect 7 and 10) and edge cases: n=1, all elements equal (deletion forbidden), all-negative array, value occurring once at an end, all-distinct values.
Stress-test with a brute-force O(n^2 * distinct) checker on small random arrays to confirm correctness.
Confirm complexity O(n log n) time / O(n) space and finalize the code within the required delimiters.
